text: Surrounded by geometric angles, glass, and bright artificial light, I feel both exposed and contemplative. The transparent walls separate spaces yet invite observation—there is an undercurrent of anticipation, as though ideas are being incubated just out of reach. The R+D wall, full of bold colors and text, reinforces the sense of inquiry and curiosity. Here, my mind is drawn to the interplay between utility and creativity, order and experimentation. I feel small but inspired, wondering how spaces shape the thoughts and possibilities of those who pass through them.
